snippet.title: Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy – Nintendo Direct 9.9.2026
snippet.description:
Put your Dandori skills to the test when Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy launches on November 12, 2026. Pre-order the Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy Upgrade Pack today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/pikmin-4-nintendo-switch-2-edition-plus-dandori-academy-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

You can now give voice commands to Oatchi using the built-in microphone on Nintendo Switch 2. 

Plus, a new mode is blooming: Dandori Academy. 

Take on challenges and test how quickly you can collect treasure within the stage. Test your Dandori skills and once you’re ready, aim for a high score! Earn medals based on how well you do and see the scores of your friends and players around the world. 

72 Dandori Academy stages will be released over time. 

#NintendoDirect #Pikmin4 

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
